title: DAOS 交易容器：原子更新與批次提交成本
titleEn: DAOS transactional containers: atomic updates and commit batching
summary: 以合成資料重建「DAOS 交易容器：原子更新與批次提交成本」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付鍵值依賴圖、交易邊界、提交成本與重試規則。
summaryEn: Reconstruct DAOS transactional containers: atomic updates and commit batching with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver key dependencies, transaction boundaries, commit costs and retry rules.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 以合成資料重建「DAOS 交易容器：原子更新與批次提交成本」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付鍵值依賴圖、交易邊界、提交成本與重試規則。
knowledge.textEn: Reconstruct DAOS transactional containers: atomic updates and commit batching with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver key dependencies, transaction boundaries, commit costs and retry rules.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 合成 T=transaction_count×commit_cost+update_count×update_cost；批次只有在應用語意允許時可合併。
knowledge.textEn: Synthetic T=transaction_count×commit_cost+update_count×update_cost; transactions can be merged only when application semantics permit.

quiz.question: 「紀錄原子性表」：若要檢查結果是否可信，哪一項提供本課的獨立驗證動作？
quiz.questionEn: Record atomicity table: Which statement provides an independent verification action for judging whether the result is credible?
options: 分開更新成本 0.8 ms 與提交 8 或 2 ms；用交易邊界圖檢查部分更新不可見。
若讀者看見半份紀錄，查是否跨交易讀取；重試若重複外部副作用，需另設 idempotency。
100 個邏輯紀錄，各更新四個欄位；每欄 0.002 ms、提交 0.08 ms。變更每四紀錄一交易。
optionsEn: Separate 0.8 ms update work from 8 or 2 ms commits; transaction-boundary diagrams check partial-update visibility.
Half-record reads suggest mismatched transaction boundaries; retries with external side effects need separate idempotency.
100 logical records with four field updates each; 0.002 ms per field and 0.08 ms per commit; batch four records per transaction.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「獨立驗證方法」。分開更新成本 0.8 ms 與提交 8 或 2 ms；用交易邊界圖檢查部分更新不可見。 與本階段判準一起判讀：只允許完整舊版或完整新版；外部服務不自動納入原子性。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies independent verification. Separate 0.8 ms update work from 8 or 2 ms commits; transaction-boundary diagrams check partial-update visibility. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Only complete old or new versions are allowed; external services are not automatically atomic.

steps.title: 紀錄原子性表 · 比較擾動與量測
steps.titleEn: Record atomicity table · Compare perturbations and measurements
steps.objective: 完成「紀錄原子性表」的比較擾動與量測，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete compare perturbations and measurements for Record atomicity table and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
分開更新成本 0.8 ms 與提交 8 或 2 ms；用交易邊界圖檢查部分更新不可見。
回到本階段實驗：將四欄 A/B/C/D 放在一個交易框，列讀者可見的提交前後版本。
把名義組與變更組並列，逐欄確認只改了預定條件；若需多變量，另開實驗編號。用同一單位檢查趨勢、偏差與判準：只允許完整舊版或完整新版；外部服務不自動納入原子性。
steps.instructionEn:
Separate 0.8 ms update work from 8 or 2 ms commits; transaction-boundary diagrams check partial-update visibility.
Return to the investigation: Place four fields A/B/C/D in a transaction box and list reader-visible versions before and after commit.
Compare nominal and changed runs column by column, confirming that only intended conditions changed. Give multi-variable experiments separate IDs. Check trend, bias, and criterion in common units: Only complete old or new versions are allowed; external services are not automatically atomic.
steps.observation: 對照組與變更組的差異能追到明確輸入或量測機制。分開更新成本 0.8 ms 與提交 8 或 2 ms；用交易邊界圖檢查部分更新不可見。
steps.observationEn: Differences between control and changed runs trace to explicit inputs or measurement mechanisms. Separate 0.8 ms update work from 8 or 2 ms commits; transaction-boundary diagrams check partial-update visibility.
steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.
steps.check: 只允許完整舊版或完整新版；外部服務不自動納入原子性。
steps.checkEn: Only complete old or new versions are allowed; external services are not automatically atomic.

quiz.question: 「紀錄原子性表」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Record atomicity table: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: 名義式 100*0.08+400*0.002 = 8.8 ms；變更式 25*0.08+400*0.002 = 2.8 ms。把 100 個提交合併為 25 個，保留 400 次欄位更新。 全部負載、量測和門檻是原創教學假設，不是產品規格。
交付鍵值依賴圖、交易邊界、提交成本與重試規則。
若讀者看見半份紀錄，查是否跨交易讀取；重試若重複外部副作用，需另設 idempotency。
optionsEn: Nominal: 100*0.08+400*0.002 = 8.8 ms; changed: 25*0.08+400*0.002 = 2.8 ms. Reduce commits from 100 to 25 while retaining 400 field updates. All workload measurements and thresholds are original teaching assumptions, not product specifications.
Deliver key dependencies, transaction boundaries, commit costs and retry rules.
Half-record reads suggest mismatched transaction boundaries; retries with external side effects need separate idempotency.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。若讀者看見半份紀錄，查是否跨交易讀取；重試若重複外部副作用，需另設 idempotency。 與本階段判準一起判讀：只允許完整舊版或完整新版；外部服務不自動納入原子性。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. Half-record reads suggest mismatched transaction boundaries; retries with external side effects need separate idempotency. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Only complete old or new versions are allowed; external services are not automatically atomic.

steps.title: 紀錄原子性表 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Record atomicity table · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「紀錄原子性表」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Record atomicity table and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
若讀者看見半份紀錄，查是否跨交易讀取；重試若重複外部副作用，需另設 idempotency。
對照「紀錄原子性表」的名義結果，分別建立系統故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。批次需保持相同的可見性契約；成本較低不授權改變應用一致性要求。
本階段必須重驗：只允許完整舊版或完整新版；外部服務不自動納入原子性。
steps.instructionEn:
Half-record reads suggest mismatched transaction boundaries; retries with external side effects need separate idempotency.
Against the nominal Record atomicity table result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Batching must preserve the visibility contract; lower cost does not authorize weaker consistency.
Reverify this criterion: Only complete old or new versions are allowed; external services are not automatically atomic.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。若讀者看見半份紀錄，查是否跨交易讀取；重試若重複外部副作用，需另設 idempotency。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Half-record reads suggest mismatched transaction boundaries; retries with external side effects need separate idempotency.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 只允許完整舊版或完整新版；外部服務不自動納入原子性。
steps.checkEn: Only complete old or new versions are allowed; external services are not automatically atomic.

steps.title: 紀錄原子性表 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Record atomicity table · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「紀錄原子性表」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Record atomicity table and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付鍵值依賴圖、交易邊界、提交成本與重試規則。
在交接件中加入「紀錄原子性表」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：只允許完整舊版或完整新版；外部服務不自動納入原子性。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：以合成資料重建「DAOS 交易容器：原子更新與批次提交成本」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付鍵值依賴圖、交易邊界、提交成本與重試規則。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver key dependencies, transaction boundaries, commit costs and retry rules.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Record atomicity table: Only complete old or new versions are allowed; external services are not automatically atomic.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Reconstruct DAOS transactional containers: atomic updates and commit batching with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver key dependencies, transaction boundaries, commit costs and retry rules. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。只允許完整舊版或完整新版；外部服務不自動納入原子性。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Only complete old or new versions are allowed; external services are not automatically atomic.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 只允許完整舊版或完整新版；外部服務不自動納入原子性。
steps.checkEn: Only complete old or new versions are allowed; external services are not automatically atomic.
